23:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: Real Time With Bill Maher
Acerbic comic Bill Maher welcomes a panel of guests from diverse parts of the political spectrum for a lively discussion of current events, as well as offering his own perspective on contemporary issues.

00:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: Have I Got News for You
Host Roy Wood Jr. and team captains Amber Ruffin and Michael Ian Black serve up a smart take on the news of the week.
